tooltips.ipAddress: Public client IP captured by the ingestion endpoint. Honors X-Forwarded-For when source is trusted.
tooltips.anonymousId: Opaque visitor id for un-identified traffic. Cleared once the visitor identifies and the row is rewired to a Contact.
tooltips.attribution: Resolved attribution snapshot (utm_*, click ids, referrer chain) at ingest time.
tooltips.value: Monetary value of the event (e.g. order total). Optional.
tooltips.contact: Set when the visitor was already identified, or backfilled by AnonymousStitcher.
tooltips.parent: Polymorphic subject — additional context (e.g. 'Pricing Page View during Opportunity O-123').
tooltips.tenant: Inherited from the parent TrackingEventType (auto-set by CascadeTenantFromEventType hook).
